name: apiosk-mcp
description: Ask a data question, review matching sources and one total price, approve the exact request, and reopen source-backed results without repurchasing.

apiosk_token.title: Apiosk connection token
apiosk_token.description: Use an existing Apiosk agent connection token. Never enter provider keys or a password.

state_directory.title: Saved Ask data
state_directory.description: Private persistent directory for saved evidence and approval recovery.

tools.name: apiosk_ask
tools.description: Start a new Ask conversation. Discover the same sources and background context as Ask. sources mode lets the user select; automatic prepares a combined plan. Never purchases.

tools.name: apiosk_capabilities
tools.description: Explain the Ask workflow, authentication limits and available interactions. No source calls.

tools.name: apiosk_sources
tools.description: List saved source options grouped by provider, with prices, subjects and inputs. Pass source_id to inspect its complete input schema. This never buys data.

tools.name: apiosk_prepare
tools.description: Review selected source_id rows and exact editable input objects, or prepare the complete automatic plan. Returns a saved quote and one total for explicit approval; never executes a source.

tools.name: apiosk_approve
tools.description: Purchase ONLY after the user explicitly approves this exact approval_id, currency and maximum total. Approval dispatch is durably recorded before sending. After errors/repeats use status, never a new purchase.

tools.name: apiosk_status
tools.description: Read saved execution, payment, partial results and current actions. Never creates a quote or reauthorizes. Set recover=true to ask Gateway to resume an already authorized worker within its original budget.

tools.name: apiosk_requote
tools.description: Refresh existing unapproved quotes without buying. Every new or changed quote must be reviewed and approved explicitly.

tools.name: apiosk_continue
tools.description: Continue a returned entity choice or missing-input action using exactly the saved action_id and its schema. Also supports cancel/retry_analysis (input:null). Never approves a new quote or executes an arbitrary paid action.

tools.name: apiosk_result
tools.description: View or export saved results and evidence without fetching or buying source data. Supports local tables/charts, filters, selected columns and JSON/CSV/HTML. Use status to refresh execution separately.

tools.name: apiosk_evidence
tools.description: Inspect an exact JSON Pointer in a saved task, including evidence, raw values, dates, provenance, coverage or derived inputs. No provider call.

tools.name: apiosk_artifact
tools.description: List saved PDF reports, evidence ZIPs and image assets. Pass the exact saved artifact_url to download a Gateway artifact; external links are returned without forwarding credentials. Never regenerates or repurchases.

tools.name: apiosk_result_page
tools.description: Read another page of an existing saved result using its read_result action. Never fetches new source data or authorizes a purchase.

tools.name: apiosk_follow_up
tools.description: Ask about saved purchased results. Gateway first routes to saved evidence, clarification, or a new source search. New data still requires a new quote and approval.

tools.name: apiosk_retry_search
tools.description: Explicitly resume or retry source discovery without approving or buying. Preserves prior purchases; a request with an approval attempt must use a new follow-up for new data.

tools.name: apiosk_chats
tools.description: List or reopen local saved Ask conversations in this credential/workspace. Import reads an existing Gateway task with Gateway access checks; it never repurchases. App chat history sync is separate.

tools.name: apiosk_integrations
tools.description: Read connected integration accounts and their availability.

tools.name: apiosk_integration_connect
tools.description: Start a requested integration connection and return its hosted consent URL. The user completes sign-in in their browser.

tools.name: apiosk_actions
tools.description: List action schemas for connected apps; an optional toolkit limits the list.

tools.name: apiosk_action_prepare
tools.description: Prepare and save exact app-action arguments from the question and saved source results. Requires a personal App session; sends no message and runs no action.

tools.name: apiosk_action_edit
tools.description: Create a new review with explicitly edited action arguments. Original reviewed or attempted actions remain unchanged.

tools.name: apiosk_action_execute
tools.description: Execute exactly the saved action only after the user requests sending/writing and approves its displayed destination/content. Never repeat after an unknown outcome.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_access
tools.description: Check whether native recurring orders are enabled. Gateway currently requires a personal App session.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_list
tools.description: Read native Apiosk recurring orders for the current account/workspace.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_read
tools.description: Read a saved native recurring order or one saved occurrence. This does not run sources or retry delivery.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_destinations
tools.description: Read available Slack delivery conversations for an owned connected account.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_channel_review
tools.description: Save the exact Slack account, channel name and visibility for review. Creates no channel, sends no message and changes no recurring order. Channel creation requires a personal App session and native recurring availability.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_channel_create
tools.description: Create only the reviewed Slack channel after the user explicitly approves its account, name and visibility. Returns the destination ID for a separate recurring quote or delivery review. Sends no message and never retries an uncertain creation.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_quote
tools.description: Price a native recurring order from saved completed tasks. Saves a review, reserves nothing, starts nothing. Requires personal App session and native recurring availability; prefer host-owned scheduling for agents.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_approve
tools.description: Approve exactly the displayed recurring price, cap, workflow, schedule and destination. This reserves funds or enables per-run charges; requires explicit user approval.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_change_review
tools.description: Read the current order and prepare a review to pause/resume/cancel it or change its delivery. Changes nothing until the saved review is applied.

tools.name: apiosk_recurring_change_apply
tools.description: Apply the exact saved recurring change after the user reviews it. Never resends an attempted change with an unknown outcome.

tools.name: apiosk_review_read
tools.description: Read a locally saved app-action or recurring review and its attempt status. This never executes or retries a write.

tools.name: apiosk_schedule_handoff
tools.description: Return an inspectable recipe for the host AI scheduler. Does not create a schedule, authorize payments, execute sources or send messages.

tools.name: apiosk_task_options
tools.description: Read a saved task’s offered source-selection and extended-analysis choices, models and saved-output references. No replan or purchase.

tools.name: apiosk_source_selection
tools.description: Reprice an unapproved saved research plan with exact offered source and subject choices. Requires a personal App session. This route cannot authorize or run sources; review the new total afterward.

tools.name: apiosk_analysis_quote
tools.description: Quote an offered extended-analysis model, enable/disable it on an unapproved plan, or quote analysis of an offered completed saved output. Requires a personal App session. Reuses evidence and never approves or executes; a new price needs explicit approval.
